_info: Bruno's Front Desk: what customers say at the Brambleford Town Hall parking permit desk. English at A2 (the content being learnt) in `de` (key kept), `en` a plainer paraphrase. Humour about bureaucracy, never about people (decision 10). Read against that before release.
